{{a|Flame Body}}{{tt|*|As a Fletchinder}} |type1=Fire |type2=Flying |nature=Brave |media=special |epnum=PS549 |numeps1=22 |pokemonname=Fletchinder |epname=An X-cuse to Come Out and Play |firstevoep=PS571 |firstevoname=Burning Fletchinder |firststagename=Fletchling |secondstagename=Fletchinder |prevonum=661 |evo1num=662 |evolution=1 |current=[[Party|With Y]] |va=no }} '''Fletchy''' (Japanese: '''ヤコちゃん''' ''Yako-chan'') is a {{p|Fletchinder}} that {{adv|Y}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and is her [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]]. She is [[level]] 34 and her [[Characteristic]] is that she is "highly curious." ==History== [[File:Fletchy carrying Y.png|thumb|left|150px|Fletchy flying Y around]] Prior to the start of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}, {{adv|Y}} took Fletchy to the [[Vaniville Town]] {{tc|Sky Trainer}} academy. Due to being jealous of her {{kal|Grace|mother}}'s status as a {{p|Rhyhorn}} racer, Y was picked on by her classmates repeatedly. One of the things she was mocked for was choosing to take Fletchy, who was a {{p|Fletchling}} at the time, to school despite her being ineligible for [[Sky Battle]]s. Fletchy debuted as a Fletchling in ''[[PS549|An X-cuse to Come Out and Play]]'', where she was seen flying to {{adv|X}}'s house alongside Y in an attempt to get X out of his house. In [[PS550|the next chapter]], Fletchy escaped [[Vaniville Town]] alongside her {{pkmn|Trainer}} to escape the destruction caused by [[Xerxer|Xerneas]] and {{p|Yveltal}} battling each other. In ''[[PS551|Inn-teresting Developments]]'', Y and Fletchy battled the [[Team Flare]] member that trapped them inside an [[Aquacorde Town]] inn. When Y noticed that X was in trouble outside, she attempted to open the window to help him but was unable to. Seeing this, Fletchy smashes the window with her beak, allowing Y to break through to get to X. [[File:Y vs Yvette.png|thumb|left|175px|Fletchy battling Yvette's Vivillon]] In ''[[PS566|Overthrowing a Tyrunt]]'', Fletchy battled alongside [[Croaky]], {{adv|Tierno}}'s {{p|Corphish}}, and {{adv|Shauna}}'s {{p|Skitty}} against {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}'s four {{p|Espurr}}. Due to learning that her mother was kidnapped by Team Flare, Y became distracted, which gave the Espurr an advantage in the battle. The Espurr were later defeated when [[Cassius]] arrived and used his {{p|Gourgeist}} to confuse them. After the group was taken to Cassius's house, Fletchy looked at her Trainer sadly when she noticed that Y had become depressed from the knowledge of her mother's fate. [[File:Y and Fletchy.png|thumb|right|150px|Fletchy and Y]] In ''[[PS571|Burning Fletchinder]]'', Fletchy battled [[Yvette]], a former classmate of Y's that had been put under mind control along with other {{tc|Sky Trainer}}s. During the battle, Yvette repeatedly taunts and mocks Y by insulting her mother. This action angers Y into defending her mother, which helped get her out of her depression. Now calmed down, Y's passion for defeating Yvette helped Fletchy to [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{p|Fletchinder}}, giving her the strength to defeat Yvette's {{p|Vivillon}}. With X defeating the {{p|Aegislash}} that put the Sky Trainers under mind control, Yvette passes out, forcing Fletchy to catch her and lift her to safety. In ''[[PS585|Pinsir Changes]]'', Fletchy flew Y around to chase [[Emma|Essentia]] through the skies of [[Anistar City]] after discovering that she was behind the attack on [[Professor Sycamore]]. After chasing Essentia down a corner, Essentia's {{p|Hawlucha}} appears and hits Fletchy with a barrage of pointed stones, knocking her out. Fletchy was later taken to a [[Pokémon Center]] to be healed. In ''[[PS592|Zygarde Agitated]]'', Fletchy helped Y as she attempted to take back the [[Key Stone]] from [[Lysandre]] that was stolen from [[Korrina]]. After {{p|Absol|Solsol}} managed to take back the Key Stone, Fletchy is taken out by a {{m|Hydro Pump}} from Lysandre's {{p|Gyarados}}. {{-}} ==Personality and characteristics== Fletchy is a kind and free-spirited Pokémon, though when she goes into {{pkmn|battle}}, she becomes focused and determined to defeat her opponent, no matter what the opponent may be. Fletchy is very smart and insightful and usually acts without needing her {{pkmn|Trainer}} to tell her what to do. She deeply cares for {{adv|Y}}, becoming sad when her Trainer was depressed.
